cause: The generated program explicitly fails when the returned order total is not 120. The prelude dependency chain passes subtotal 100 unchanged through pricing.base, while pricing.rule/apply-standard adds 2 (despite its docstring saying 20), producing 102 rather than 120; this triggers the explicit failure.
evidence: execution_errors reported workflow_failed with reason explicit_failure for evaluation workflow-evaluation-1.
The exact generated program was (let [quote (orders/place {"subtotal" 100})] (if (= (get quote "total") 120) quote (fail {:kind "order-total-mismatch"}))).
pricing.tax/add-standard calls pricing.rule/apply-standard on pricing.base/amount subtotal.
pricing.rule/apply-standard is (+ subtotal 2), so the computed total is 102, not 120.
